Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses This tender is a non- divisible tender. 6. Bid Qualifications Criteria: BQC A: Financial Criteria The bidder or its OEM shall have successfully supplied the same or similar category product, namely an industrial machine / customized equipment for SC valve lock-nut removal or comparable industrial valve / component assembly and disassembly, to any Central Government / State Government organization / PSU / Public Listed Company during at least one of the last three completed financial years preceding the bid opening date. The bidder shall have an operational manufacturing facility in India for the manufacture of mechanical systems of similar application, ensuring timely supply of the equipment. Alternatively, if the bidder is an authorized dealer or distributor, they shall submit a valid authorization certificate issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). For MSE vendors, there is relaxation in the BQC which will be as under: (As per Circular No.MA.TEC.POL.CON.3A dated 26th Oct 2020. The bidder or its OEM (themselves or through reseller(s)) should have supplied same or similar category product(s) of value not less than ₹45,000/- in at least one of the last three completed financial years preceding the bid opening date to any Central / State Government organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Documentary evidence shall comprise Purchase Order / Work Order / LOA and Completion Certificate / Final Bill / Payment Certificate or other conclusive evidence of satisfactory completion. Any relaxation to eligible MSEs / Start-ups shall be applicable only as permitted by current BPCL procurement guidelines and the bid conditions. Where the bidder is a dealer/distributor/reseller, the experience of the OEM may be considered subject to submission of valid OEM authorization for the tender and documentary evidence establishing the OEM's credentials. Note: To ensure more participation which would lead to competitive rates, Limits have been fixed as above. All the documents required as per BQC A shall be certified as per the documents verification clause & and submitted along with the price bid. BQC B: Financial Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three completed financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) should be ₹45,000/- Documentary evidence in the form of certified audited Balance Sheets / Profit & Loss Accounts or a certificate from the Chartered

Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating turnover for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than three years, the average turnover for completed financial years after constitution shall be considered. BQC C: Financial – Profitable Operation Criteria Net Worth of the Bidder / OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. “Net Worth” = “Equity + Reserves & Surplus” DEFINITION OF SIMILAR WORK Tenderer should submit experience of having successfully Industrial Pillar Drill Machine / Radial Drill Machine / Heavy Duty Drill Machine or other machines used in manufacturing plants/workshop. LPG bottling plants, refineries, petrochemical plants, engineering workshops, steel plants, or other industrial establishments, during the last three years ending on the last day of the month before the month in which applications are invited. Similar supply means supply of industrial machines or customized equipment for valve / component lock-nut removal or comparable assembly / disassembly applications to any Central / State Government organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. The bidder / OEM shall demonstrate capability to manufacture and supply the machine in accordance with BPCL's approved technical specification and drawings. Copies of all the certificates/drawings submitted, duly authenticated by the bidder, product catalogue, technical datasheet and quality assurance plan will be verified with the originals by BPCL. Also below technical documents required while submitting the bid. Documentation Required: Bidder shall furnish Annual Report/ audited balance sheets including Profit and Loss Accounts for previous three financial years along with the Bid to establish Bidder's conformance to financial criteria and prove existence since three years. In case a bidder (a Parent Company) is having wholly owned subsidiaries but only a single consolidated annual report is prepared and audited which includes the financial details of their wholly owned subsidiaries, consolidated audited annual report shall be considered for establishing the financial criteria subject to statutory auditor of the bidder certifying that separate annual report of bidder (without the financial data of subsidiaries) is not prepared and audited. Further, in case a bidder is a subsidiary company and separate annual report of the bidder is not prepared & audited, but only a consolidated annual report of the Parent Company is available, consolidated audited annual report shall be considered for establishing the financial criteria subject to statutory auditor of the parent company certifying that separate annual report of bidder is not prepared and audited. In case the financial year closing date is within 6 months of original bid due date and Audited annual report of immediately preceding financial year is not available, Bidder has the option to

submit the financial details of the three previous years immediately prior to the last financial year. The certificate confirming financial criteria with CA verification shall also be valid, provided CA NO and sign and stamp along with name is available on document. In case vendor submits BPCL Work Order/P.O. in technical criteria, certification is not mandatory against Technical Qualification Criteria. Completed value in such case will be cross checked from BPCL’s SAP system and completion certificate/other documents to satisfy completed value will not be mandatory. All charges of the Third Party for attestation and verification shall be borne by the Bidders. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
